messages:
jess: quick help please  my dad got discharged with a PICC and needs daily home infusion. Agency says theyre out-of-network and wants payment up front. Is there any way to get them to direct-bill or get a retro auth?

sara (People Ops): hi jess  sorry to hear. Short: yes, sometimes you can get direct-bill or a retroactive auth, but it depends. First step: ask agency to submit a precert/prior auth anyway and request direct-bill. If insurer denies for network, ask them to bill and mark as "emergency/medically necessary" then we can escalate.

jess: ok asking them. if they insist I pay, can I get reimbursed later? what paperwork do I need?

sara (People Ops): you can request reimbursement. Keep: itemized receipt, proof of payment (card statement), the physician order, and the agency claim with CPT/HCPCS codes. Also save any phone confirmation or email saying they will submit to insurer. Submit to insurer as an out-of-network claim and copy people-ops@redwood.com so we can help chase.

benefits-bot: FYI automated note  Prior auth typical turnaround 3-5 business days; retro-authorizations are possible but not guaranteed. If urgent, ask provider to request expedited review.

mike: vendor tactic: ask for a payment plan and a written statement that they will file claim. That reduces immediate OOP and gives time to get auth.

jess: vendor agreed to file claim and will try to direct-bill. they asked for a screenshot of e-card and member DOB. Is that ok?

sara (People Ops): screenshot of e-card + DOB is usually enough for initial verification. But insist they include member ID and group number on claim and attach the auth number when it arrives. If they bill with a different business name, get their billing DBA and NPI.

jess: any short text I can send the agency to request direct-bill, auth, and estimate?

sara (People Ops): use this short copy/paste: 

```
Subject: Prior Auth & Direct-Bill Request  [Member Name]

Hi [Agency Billing],

Please submit a prior authorization for home infusion nursing (PICC care + daily infusion x[days]) for [Member Name] (DOB: [MM/DD/YYYY], Member ID: [########], Group: [######]). Attach: signed physician order, plan of care, and med list with doses. Please confirm:
1) Will you direct-bill the insurer? If not, can you provide an itemized estimate and a payment plan option?
2) Please submit authorization and include the auth number on the claim.
3) Billing NPI and billing entity name/DBA for claims.

Please send confirmations and estimates to [jess@email.com].

Thanks,
Jess
```

benfits-bot: note: typo in last bot line above (benfits -> benefits) :)

sara (People Ops): thanks for flag, benefits-bot. jess  if anything is denied or they ask you to pay and you want help, forward the EOB/receipt to people-ops@redwood.com and we'll escalate to the insurer. Good luck!
